unverified.firing_order: 1-4-3-8-7-6-5-2. GM Z06 spec sheet ('Firing Order: 1-4-3-8-7-6-5-2') and AA1Car ('firing order for the Corvette C8 Z06 LT6 ... is 1-4-3-8-7-6-5-2'). GM Authority/corvsport only reprint GM's sheet (count once). The identical order is independently published for the LT7 sibling (Race Engine Technology, Street Machine, GM ZR1 sheet), but only 2 independent sources name the LT6 itself.
unverified.fuel_type: Premium unleaded gasoline - The Drive ('Premium fuel required'); Wikipedia ('Gasoline'). GM's Z06 release does not state octane; MotorTrend/Hagerty say premium only for the LT7. EPA lists premium but EPA is limited to displacement/cyl/induction per brief.
unverified.rod_length_in: Not published by GM or any source found (forged titanium rods).
